nbaInjuries.name: Luka Doncic
nbaInjuries.note: Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Paolo Banchero
nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Jamal Murray
nbaInjuries.note: Murray is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to a left shin contusion.

nbaInjuries.name: Scottie Barnes
nbaInjuries.note: Barnes (adductor) was a limited participant in Sunday's practice and will be listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies,

nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Davis
nbaInjuries.note: Davis (ankle) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.

nbaInjuries.name: Nikola Jokic
nbaInjuries.note: Jokic (elbow) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Houston.

nbaInjuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
nbaInjuries.note: Haliburton (hamstring) is progressing well but does not have a timetable to return, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Keyonte George
nbaInjuries.note: George will not return to Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right ankle injury.

nbaInjuries.name: Brandon Ingram
nbaInjuries.note: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
nbaInjuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
